name: Lincoln Plastics
old_description: Lincoln Plastics is a Nebraska-based custom extrusion manufacturer.
about:
Lincoln Plastics was founded in 1948 in Lincoln, Nebraska. The company operates as part of the PCE family of companies, alongside its sister division HTI Plastics, which provides injection molding services. No founder names are disclosed.

The company specializes in custom plastic profile extrusion, offering co-extrusion of two materials or colors, flexible and rigid profiles, pipe and tube extrusion, and proprietary Flexiduct cord and cable management systems. Its 25,000-square-foot facility houses in-line quality processes and serves both large and small clients with high production capacity.

Lincoln Plastics serves agricultural irrigation OEMs with components such as drop pipes, hose weights, drive shaft tubes, and PVC U-pipe and U-joint covers. It also supplies office, tradeshow, garage, and home markets with Flexiduct cable management products. Customers are located nationwide and internationally.

The company emphasizes quick order turnaround enabled by its Midwest location, ISO 9001:2015 certification, and a quality management system that includes product-specific quality plans and documented process checks.
